text:
Leah Ortiz: Thanks for a packed all-hands — starting this thread for quick clarifications, links, and short action items. Please ack and add an ETA if you	are an owner.

Sam W: Ack. I'll take point on the SLA copy update. I think "service target latency" is clearer than "guarantee". Will post a one-paragraph option by Tue AM.

Daniel P: I'll run the Dedicated pool capacity simulation and feed numbers into pricing. Filing ticket PRIC-2108 now. Expect a rough estimate by next Wed.

Nina Gupta: Private deployment packaging: MVP timeline end of Q2 is still OK but need to confirm KMS handoff and ops playbook. I'll spin up a checklist in Confluence and tag Legal.

eng-bot: Slides and recording: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/apr-2026  (recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/efgh5678)

Sam W: Quick question for Product: do we want separate latency targets for small vs large sequences? If yes, I'll draft both.

Leah Ortiz: Good call. Yes: two buckets (<=512 tokens, >512 tokens). Target P95 for small sequences 200ms, large sequences 500ms. Add to SLA draft.

Daniel P: Noted. I'll include perf numbers for both buckets in PRIC-2108. Also adding fallback policy note.

Nina Gupta: Legal ask: any extra export-control constraints for on-prem EU customers? @Legal please chime in.

Sam W: I'll include a clause that Dedicated SLAs are subject to configuration (quantization, batching) and may vary. Minimal customer-facing language only; details in contract appendix.

Leah Ortiz: Action summary: Sam  SLA draft (two buckets) -> Tue AM; Daniel  capacity + pricing -> PRIC-2108 by Wed; Nina  on-prem packaging checklist & legal tag -> update Confluence by EOW. Everyone please react here with :white_check_mark: when done.

Daniel P: Ack :white_check_mark: (added initial numbers to PRIC-2108)

Sam W: Ack (will post draft Monday night)

Nina Gupta: Ack (confluence checklist created, tagging Legal)

Leah Ortiz: Thanks — closing this follow-up in 72h unless there are more questions. If you need help, DM me or ping #product-leads.
